title: Unit-Chern biproduct arrow and tower projective trace
statement: For a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a scheme $S$, let $P=\mathbf P^1_S$ and take normalized finite Chern data from [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal], line-pullback data from [def-sp-tower-class-pullback] and exact tensor/Hom twists from [def-sp-tower-class-twisting]. Define projective data as the actual geometry for $q:P\to S$ of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], the normalized coefficient and line pullbacks and positive tensor transport, with invertibility of its specified projection mate on the coefficient unit. Define the first summand arrow by the adjunction unit. Define the second by taking the adjoint of $c_1(\mathcal O_P(1))$, transporting by the inverse projection comparison, applying the negative twist, and shifting by $-2$ with canonical cancellation comparisons. Define $b_q:A_S\oplus A_S(-1)[-2]\to Rq_*A_P$ as their biproduct map. Conditional on its invertibility, define $\operatorname{Tr}_q:Rq_*A_P(1)[2]\to A_S$ literally by twisting and shifting $b_q^{-1}$, taking its second projection and contracting the dual line. Also define the twisted-unit component using the normalized line pullback. This defines the arrows; the four-clause tower theorem separately supplies the splitting.
